entries.en: The geologist left the allivalite in place and photographed the exposed face.
entries.zh: 地质学家让那块橄长岩留在原处，并拍下了它露出的岩面。

entries.en: The accountant questioned the allocability of the travel costs to that grant.
entries.zh: 会计质疑能否把那些差旅费分摊到该项资助中。

entries.en: Each allocatee received written confirmation of the space assigned to them.
entries.zh: 每位受分配者都收到了书面通知，确认分配给自己的空间。

entries.en: The geological map traces the edge of the allochthon across the valley.
entries.zh: 这张地质图标出了移置体边缘穿过山谷的走向。

entries.en: Her allodynia made even the soft bedsheet feel painful against her skin.
entries.zh: 由于异常性疼痛，连柔软的床单碰到她的皮肤都会让她觉得痛。

entries.en: The analyst attributed the uneven results to the allogeneity of the samples.
entries.zh: 分析员把结果不一致归因于样品的异质性。

entries.en: The monkeys resumed allogrooming once the disturbance near their tree had ended.
entries.zh: 树旁的骚动结束后，猴子们又开始相互理毛。

entries.en: The two laboratories reported different allolactose concentrations for the same sample.
entries.zh: 两家实验室对同一样品报告了不同的异乳糖浓度。

entries.en: Allon caught the falling tray before it struck the tiled floor.
entries.zh: 阿隆接住了掉落的托盘，没让它砸到瓷砖地板上。

entries.en: An allonge provided the extra space needed for the additional signatures.
entries.zh: 一张附笺提供了增加的签名所需的额外空间。

entries.en: The author published under an allonym to conceal her involvement.
entries.zh: 那位作者以假托的名字发表作品，以掩饰自己参与了创作。

entries.en: The young animal spent the afternoon with an alloparent rather than its mother.
entries.zh: 那只幼兽整个下午都由非亲生的照料者陪伴，而不是和母亲在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 异双亲；非亲生照料者〔复数〕
entries.en: Several alloparents helped care for the young while their mothers fed.
entries.zh: 幼兽的母亲们进食时，一些非亲生照料者帮忙照顾它们。

entries.en: The linguistics class examined allophony in recordings of everyday speech.
entries.zh: 语言学课堂通过日常话语录音研究音位变体现象。

entries.en: The researchers compared the chromosome sets of the newly formed allopolyploids.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了新形成的异源多倍体的染色体组。

entries.en: Her dissertation examines allopolyploidy in closely related groups of plants.
entries.zh: 她的学位论文研究亲缘关系密切的植物类群中的异源多倍性。

entries.en: The conservator compared the old Alloprene coating with a later repair layer.
entries.zh: 修复师把旧的 Alloprene 氯化橡胶涂层与后来修补的涂层进行了比较。

entries.en: The chromatogram showed allose alongside the other sugars in the mixture.
entries.zh: 色谱图显示，混合物中除其他糖外还有阿洛糖。

entries.en: The biochemists investigated whether allostery could explain the enzyme's changing activity.
entries.zh: 生物化学家们研究了变构效应能否解释该酶活性的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 受分配的人〔allottee的异体拼写〕
entries.en: The allotee asked when the assigned room would become available.
entries.zh: 那位受分配者询问何时能够使用分给自己的房间。

entries.en: The study compared plants with allotetraploidy against their parental lines.
entries.zh: 这项研究把具有异源四倍性的植物与其亲本品系进行了比较。

entries.en: The allotmenteer covered the young beans before the overnight frost.
entries.zh: 那位小块园地经营者在夜间霜冻来临前盖好了幼嫩的豆苗。

entries.en: The researcher compared the same allotone in several speakers' recordings.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了几位说话者录音中的同一种调位变体。

entries.en: A fault in the allotter sent two calls to the same operator.
entries.zh: 呼叫分配器发生故障，把两个呼叫都接给了同一位话务员。

entries.en: The committee disputed the allowability of photographs in the examination room.
entries.zh: 委员会对考场内是否允许出现照片存在争议。

entries.en: The captain chose an allrounder who could both bat and bowl well.
entries.zh: 队长选择了一位击球和投球都很出色的全能球员。

entries.en: The caller asked whether the letter had really come from Allstate.
entries.zh: 打电话的人问，那封信是否真的是好事达保险寄来的。

entries.en: Allum cleaned the muddy boots before putting them beside the heater.
entries.zh: 阿勒姆清理了沾满泥的靴子，然后把它们放在取暖器旁。

entries.en: She struck an allumette to light the candle beside the bed.
entries.zh: 她划着一根火柴，点亮了床边的蜡烛。

entries.en: The survey distinguished several alluvia beneath the level farmland.
entries.zh: 勘测辨认出了平坦农田下方的几层冲积层。

entries.en: The customer asked Allway for a replacement copy of the invoice.
entries.zh: 顾客向爱威公司索要了一份补开的发票副本。

entries.en: The chemist compared allylamine with a second amine in the experiment.
entries.zh: 化学家在实验中把丙烯胺与另一种胺进行了比较。

entries.en: The team repeated the allylation after obtaining an unexpectedly low yield.
entries.zh: 在得到意外偏低的产率后，团队重新进行了烯丙基化反应。

entries.en: The proposed molecule contains an allyloxy group at the marked position.
entries.zh: 提出的分子结构在标记位置含有一个烯丙氧基。

entries.en: The laboratory ordered allylurea for a comparison with the earlier compounds.
entries.zh: 实验室订购了烯丙基脲，以便与先前的化合物进行比较。

entries.en: Allyn offered the last slice of cake to the youngest visitor.
entries.zh: 阿林把最后一块蛋糕让给了最年幼的访客。

entries.en: Allyssa found enough spare tiles to repair the broken corner.
entries.zh: 阿莉莎找到了足够的备用瓷砖，可以修补破损的一角。

entries.en: The old ticket showed our destination as Alma-Ata.
entries.zh: 旧车票上写着，我们的目的地是阿拉木图。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔马达〔葡萄牙城市名〕
entries.en: Their friends in Almada offered to keep the extra suitcase.
entries.zh: 他们在阿尔马达的朋友提出帮忙保管那个多出来的行李箱。

entries.en: Alman measured the shelf twice before cutting the board.
entries.zh: 奥尔曼在切割木板之前把架子的尺寸量了两遍。

entries.en: Almand left the muddy bicycle outside the back entrance.
entries.zh: 奥尔曼德把沾满泥的自行车留在了后门外。

entries.en: The almanographer corrected the dates before sending the pages to the printer.
entries.zh: 年历编纂者把页面送交印刷前，先校正了日期。

entries.en: Almanza carried the sleeping child upstairs without switching on the light.
entries.zh: 阿尔曼萨没有开灯，把睡着的孩子抱上了楼。

entries.en: In the story, Almasy finds an unopened letter inside the locked drawer.
entries.zh: 在故事中，阿尔马西在锁着的抽屉里发现了一封未拆的信。

entries.en: We arranged to meet our travelling companions in Almaty.
entries.zh: 我们约好在阿拉木图与同行的旅伴会合。

entries.en: Almay brought a folding chair for the neighbour with a sore knee.
entries.zh: 阿尔马伊给膝盖疼的邻居带来了一把折叠椅。

entries.en: Almendros asked for the music to be turned down during the call.
entries.zh: 阿尔门德罗斯要求在通话期间把音乐调低。

entries.en: Almeria tucked the envelope into her bag before greeting the visitors.
entries.zh: 阿尔梅里亚先把信封塞进包里，然后迎接访客。

entries.en: The poem contrasts divine almightiness with the narrator's sense of helplessness.
entries.zh: 这首诗把神的全能与叙述者的无助感作了对比。

entries.en: Almir set the alarm early enough to catch the first ferry.
entries.zh: 阿尔米尔把闹钟设得很早，以便赶上第一班渡轮。

entries.en: She kept the folded blankets on the upper shelf of the almirah.
entries.zh: 她把折好的毯子放在衣橱的上层隔板上。

entries.en: Almo checked that everyone had a ticket before the bus arrived.
entries.zh: 公交车来之前，阿尔莫检查了每个人是否都有票。

entries.en: The historian compared accounts kept by two neighbouring almonries.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两家相邻施赈所保存的账目。

entries.en: In the novel, a hungry traveller seeks food at the almonry.
entries.zh: 在小说中，一名饥饿的旅人在施赈所求取食物。

entries.en: Almonte moved the fragile bowls away from the edge of the table.
entries.zh: 阿尔蒙特把易碎的碗挪离了桌边。

entries.en: Almos remembered to bring the extension lead for the projector.
entries.zh: 阿尔莫斯记得带来了放映机所需的延长线。

entries.en: The old alms-house stood beside a small garden and a washhouse.
entries.zh: 那座旧救济院旁边有一座小花园和一间洗衣房。

entries.en: The narrator describes the anonymous gift as an almsdeed rather than a bargain.
entries.zh: 叙述者把那份匿名礼物描述为善举，而非交易。

entries.meaningZh: 依赖施舍生活的贫民〔旧式用语〕
entries.en: The account records bread distributed to the village's almsfolk.
entries.zh: 那份账目记录了向村中依赖施舍生活的贫民分发的面包。

entries.en: The almsman thanked the donor before returning to his lodgings.
entries.zh: 那位受救济者向捐助人道谢后，回到了住处。

entries.en: The register lists the almsmen who received winter clothing.
entries.zh: 登记簿列出了领到冬衣的受救济者。

entries.meaningZh: 受救济的女人〔旧式用语〕
entries.en: In the tale, an almswoman shares her bread with a lost child.
entries.zh: 故事中，一位受救济的女人把自己的面包分给了一个迷路的孩子。

entries.en: The two stars lay on the same almucantar in her sketch.
entries.zh: 在她的草图中，这两颗星位于同一个等高圈上。

entries.en: The actor wore an almuce over his shoulders for the church scene.
entries.zh: 演员在那场教堂戏中把皮兜帽披在了肩上。

entries.en: Almudena hung a bright scarf over the chair to mark her place.
entries.zh: 阿尔穆德纳把一条鲜艳的围巾搭在椅子上，标明那是自己的座位。

entries.en: Almy persuaded the group to wait until the rain had eased.
entries.zh: 阿尔米说服大家等雨小一点再走。

entries.en: The cloth remained in the warehouse until the alnage was complete.
entries.zh: 毛织品一直留在仓库里，直到检验完成。

entries.meaningZh: 毛织品检验官〔旧时英国〕
entries.en: In the historical drama, the alnager examines the merchant's cloth.
entries.zh: 在这部历史剧中，毛织品检验官检查了商人的布匹。

entries.en: The carpenter saved a small piece of aloewood for the lid's inlay.
entries.zh: 木匠留了一小块沉香木，用作盒盖的镶嵌材料。

entries.en: Alon marked the narrow steps with a strip of bright tape.
entries.zh: 阿龙用一条鲜艳的胶带标出了狭窄的台阶。

entries.en: Alondra left a spare umbrella beside the office door.
entries.zh: 阿朗德拉在办公室门旁放了一把备用雨伞。

entries.en: The alongshoreman helped shift the heavy crates before the next ship arrived.
entries.zh: 下一艘船到来前，那位码头装卸工人帮忙搬动了沉重的板条箱。

entries.en: Alonso wrapped the sandwiches while we filled the water bottles.
entries.zh: 我们往水瓶里装水时，阿朗索包好了三明治。

entries.en: She added chopped aloo to the pan with the peas.
entries.zh: 她把切好的土豆和豌豆一起放进了锅里。

entries.en: Alot carried the sleeping puppy home in a cardboard box.
entries.zh: 阿洛特把睡着的小狗装在纸箱里带回家。

entries.en: Alou kept the front gate open until the last guests arrived.
entries.zh: 阿洛乌一直敞着前门，直到最后一批客人到来。

entries.en: The cattle would return to the alpage when the mountain snow melted.
entries.zh: 山上的雪融化后，牛群会回到高山夏牧场。

entries.en: A torn alpargata lay beside the path after the festival.
entries.zh: 节庆活动过后，一只破了的帆布轻便鞋落在小路旁。

entries.en: Alpe brought an extra pair of binoculars for the birdwatching walk.
entries.zh: 阿尔普为观鸟徒步多带了一副双筒望远镜。

entries.en: In the play, the guard leans an alpeen against the wall.
entries.zh: 在戏中，卫兵把一根粗头短棍靠在墙上。

entries.en: Alpen gathered the empty cups while the visitors put on their coats.
entries.zh: 访客们穿外套时，阿尔彭收起了空杯子。

entries.en: The musician rested the alpenhorn on the grass between performances.
entries.zh: 两次演奏之间，乐手把木制长号角放在草地上。

entries.en: Alper found the missing screw beneath the folded newspaper.
entries.zh: 阿尔珀在折起的报纸下面找到了丢失的螺丝。

entries.en: Alpers moved the chairs back after the children finished their game.
entries.zh: 孩子们玩完游戏后，阿尔珀斯把椅子搬回了原处。

entries.en: Alpert carried the borrowed ladder back to the neighbour's shed.
entries.zh: 阿尔珀特把借来的梯子搬回了邻居的棚屋。

entries.en: Alpes thanked the volunteers before locking the community hall.
entries.zh: 阿尔普锁上社区礼堂之前，向志愿者们表示了感谢。

entries.en: The child pushed the alphabet-soup bowl aside to make room for bread.
entries.zh: 孩子把那碗字母形面片汤推到一边，给面包腾出位置。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the alphacellulose content of the two paper samples.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了两份纸样中的阿尔法纤维素含量。
